contract: See CONTRACT.md. Apply dark grey layers and bright orange actions throughout the existing local agent workspace. Keep conversations readable, selection/focus visible, and permission/spending states clear. Preserve user-configured agent colour chips, responsive panel layouts, approval requirements and disabled autopilot. Local reference: the working Vizor interface and the user's requested palette.

accessibility.evidence: Axe A/AA checks pass across onboarding, conversation, multi-agent workspace, orchestration, audit and spending controls. Orange filled controls use dark text; secondary text is neutral grey. Keyboard focus, labelled controls and reduced-motion behavior are checked; not a complete assistive-technology certification.

responsive.evidence: Inspected 1440x900 and 390x844 renders. Desktop grids and approval sidebars keep their hierarchy, mobile views stack without horizontal overflow, and long-history composers remain reachable. Colour changes do not alter panel sizing or navigation behavior.

loading.evidence: Provider connection and proposal/save controls keep their busy/disabled feedback. Active provider streams show Thinking and Stop; independent agents continue streaming.

empty.evidence: Onboarding retains provider instructions, empty chats retain their composer, and the approval queue explains how to create a draft. Charcoal cards and orange primary actions establish hierarchy.

error.evidence: Invalid credentials and provider errors remain readable in distinct error surfaces. Budget exhaustion gives recovery guidance and blocks generation, including connection replacement, without losing an existing key.

partial.evidence: Stopped streams retain their partial text and explicit unavailable/partial cost labels. Conservative budget accounting and restart recovery pass existing checks.

success.evidence: Connected providers, saved layouts, edited/approved drafts and spending controls give visible confirmations. Orange selections stay distinct from hover and disabled states.

permission.evidence: Autopilot off remains visible; orange Approve controls are explicit human actions. Proposals do not execute automatically, owner boundaries remain tested, and audit history retains approval provenance.

renderedEvidence.observation: Neutral charcoal canvas and provider cards with bright orange branding/navigation; key-test controls are visibly disabled until input is entered.
Grey conversation/context/draft panels use orange for active navigation, focus and approval; readable white/grey text remains the main content.
Conversation, partial-response status and composer remain readable at narrow width, with a bright orange New agent action and orange selection/focus styling.
Pending proposal, explicit approval/edit/reject controls and orange selected-state accents fit the mobile page without overflow.
